convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom for SuperTrend-based Trend Magic indicator (CCI+ATR composite), which requires understanding and replicating the custom indicator logic in Python; also has multi-condition entry with indicator level checks

derived_values.name: Trend Magic line value (CCI-ATR composite stop-and-reverse level)
derived_values.formula: CCI(AtrPeriod) applied; if CCI>0 then Low-ATR*Multiplier else High+ATR*Multiplier, then smoothed/shifted

other_exits: Signal reversal closes existing position before opening opposite

custom_logic_notes: Trend Magic is a composite indicator combining CCI with ATR-based stops (similar to SuperTrend but using CCI instead of ATR direction). The indicator line acts as both entry signal (price crossover) and dynamic support/resistance. Trend direction is confirmed by comparing current and previous Trend Magic values (rising=bullish, falling=bearish). SL/TP values are in points and adjusted for 5-digit brokers by multiplying by 10.
python_conversion_notes: Must replicate Trend Magic indicator logic: compute CCI period, ATR period and multiplier, then construct the stop-and-reverse line (if CCI>0: Low-ATR*Mult, else High+ATR*Mult, with no-lower/no-higher rule vs previous bar). This is the core custom indicator that cannot be directly translated from a builtin. Entry uses previous bar values ([1]) for signal confirmation to avoid repainting. SL/TP in points require point-to-price conversion. Digit adjustment (5-digit vs 4-digit) must be handled explicitly in Python.
